section: v4, D (preregistration): the CVC probe with a stop rule
dataset: datos.gov.co d3ft-wu2b (CVC, Calidad del agua del Rio Cauca; CC BY-SA 4.0)
query: $select=estaciones, count(turbiedad_unt), min/max(fecha_de_muestreo); $where=fecha_de_muestreo >= '2018-12-01' AND turbiedad_unt IS NOT NULL; $group=estaciones
rule: at least 3 points with >= 30 turbidity samples since 2018-12-01 that pass the station rule (main channel >= 150 m)
